_source: Measured on CeMLeadingLogMix1BB, 3 files (~24950 events) per worker, warm page cache, 48-core host. pyevtana rows are read-and-normalize only (bench_handler.py); the pyfitter row runs its full selection (bench_pyfitter.py) and is shown for bandwidth comparison only, since it reads the same bytes.

before fixes.note: as first written: batches sized from the whole tree, partitioner opened every file

after batch-size fix.note: batches sized from the selected branches only

after partitioning fix.note: partitioner no longer opens every file in the parent process

uproot default handler.note: final code, uproot's own source instead of MemmapSource

pyfitter / pyutils.note: full selection, not read-only; same files and branch list
